messages:
nandi: Morning team  quick onboarding Qs for South Africa payroll and benefits. I started last Wednesday (5/3). Portal shows medical aid pending, UIF pending, and my bank account shows as 'unverified'. Will medical aid start immediately or next month? Also curious about maternity/paternity leave eligibility and reimbursements for relocation.

thabo-peopleops: welcome, Nandi! :wave: quick notes: medical aid enrollment typically activates at the start of the next month after benefits submission unless the provider confirms back-dating. UIF registration is handled by EOR and can take 1-3 weeks. For parental leave, statutory maternity/paternity benefits depend on UIF contributions; check the leave policy in the offer packet for company top-ups.

nandi: thanks. where do I fix bank verification? I uploaded banking details but it still says 'unverified' and payday is coming.

hr-bot: Bank verification helper: Please confirm account number and branch code and upload a bank statement or bank confirmation via People Ops portal > Payroll > Bank details. Accepted: pdf/png/jpg. If you need manual verification, attach a masked screenshot here (only last 4 digits).

karin-payroll: hi Nandi  if bank remains unverified at payroll cutoff, payroll will issue salary via an interim payment method (e.g., paycard) and then reissue to your bank once verified. Cutoff for May payroll is the 20th. Please DM me your last 4 digits and we'll push verification.

nandi: got it, uploading masked statement now. about relocation: I submitted relocation receipts for flights and shipping. Will those be grossed up or taxed?

thabo-peopleops: relocation tax treatment depends on country and EOR policy. In RSA, some relocation reimbursements are taxable unless substantiated or structured as tax-free allowances. We typically run reimbursements gross and payroll will apply withholding based on tax rules.

karin-payroll: correct  we'll review receipts. If any item qualifies for tax-free treatment (e.g., temporary accommodation under certain conditions), we'll code accordingly. Reimbursements processed on separate reimbursement run; expect within 2 payroll cycles after approval. If you need faster, mark as "expedite" on the claim and cc payroll.

nandi: last: maternity/paternity eligibility  I may become eligible for parental leave in 9 months. Do I need to contribute to UIF now to meet eligibility?

thabo-peopleops: UIF eligibility requires active contributions; eligibility windows vary. Best practice: ensure your UIF registration completes ASAP. Once registered and contributions are recorded, statutory claims can be made. Company leave top-ups and parental policies are in the employee handbook; feel free to DM me for specifics and we can walk through examples.

nandi: huge help  thanks all. i'll attach bank statement and relocation receipts shortly and ping if bank still shows unverified.

karin-payroll: received masked statement, starting manual verification. welcome aboard and congrats in advance on the future parental planning! :tada:
